caption: The drawing features a central composition with a black rectangular background surrounded by a simple orange-brown wooden frame. In the middle, there is a colorful, stylized floral arrangement emerging from a vase-like shape. At the top, a large flower with yellow, red, black, and white elements radiates outward with petal-like forms, incorporating geometric and floral patterns. Below the central flower are two symmetrical, smaller flowers and leaves. At the base, a heart with a red and yellow border contains German text written in a decorative script. Flanking the heart on both sides are two small, stylized birds in shades of blue, yellow, and green, facing each other. Behind and around the heart and birds, there are additional floral and ribbon elements in yellow and red hues. Below the heart, on a rectangular plaque with a red border, the name "Jacob Bauer" is written. Outside the frame, on the lower right of the plain background, the name "FRITZ BOEHMER." is printed in uppercase letters.
title: Memorial-Pennsylvania Fractur and Cut-out Commemorating Jacob Bauer
